vocabulary.definition: rapid increase in the number or amount of something
vocabulary.example: The proliferation of nuclear weapons is a major global concern.

vocabulary.definition: speeds up or increases the rate of something
vocabulary.example: The company accelerates its production to meet the high demand.

vocabulary.definition: provided with necessary items or tools
vocabulary.example: The soldiers are equipped with advanced weaponry.

vocabulary.definition: relating to or traveling between continents
vocabulary.example: The airline offers intercontinental flights to various destinations.

vocabulary.definition: official measures taken against a country to make it obey international laws
vocabulary.example: The United Nations imposed sanctions on the rogue nation.

vocabulary.definition: separated from others; alone or lonely
vocabulary.example: The remote village felt isolated from the rest of the world.
